note:
Re-measured at 18; the floor said 21. Not this commit's doing -- the tree reads 18 with the ported modules present and 18 with them held aside, so the three were repaid by somebody who did not bank them, and an exact ratchet fails in the falling direction too.

The ten ported modules add none: every remaining unresolved call is in a module that predates them (sale_edi_ubl 6, l10n_it_edi 3, l10n_cl 3, and five singletons). Six further modules were pulled from the mirror in the same pass and dropped again rather than banked, because they call base APIs this fork does not have -- l10n_fr_pdp alone had 31 into an account_peppol that diverges from the mirror by +4310/-18885 lines.
